description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (GC session, BEAM comparison on bench, fz develop vs BEAM 28.3). Investigation first.
Evidence: enum copies 119.8 MB in 47 collections while allocating 36 MB; BEAM copies 4.3 MB in 3. GC time 39.9 ms vs 0.44 ms.
Compare against BEAM's grow-to-fit young heap (erl_gc.c heap_sizes, the shrink rule at 1536). Feeds the fz-9x7.15 and fz-9x7.11 re-tests. Memory judged in in-use bytes (fz-9x7.16).
title: enum's young generation is sized so its live list is not copied over and over
